about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Custom printing on garments, from a single piece to a bulk run.
about.story_p1: Costaspressjr prints custom apparel to order. Send us your own artwork or choose one of our ready-made designs, and we print it on the garment and size you pick.
about.story_p2: We print on t-shirts, long sleeves, tank tops, v-necks, polos and hoodies, in a range of colours and sizes. Orders can be a single piece or a bulk run — the per-unit price drops as the quantity goes up.
about.mission_lead: What we aim for on every order:

info.faq.title: FAQ
info.faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the things people ask most.
info.faq.a1: Most orders are printed and ready within 3–5 business days. Large orders or complex custom designs may take a little longer.
info.faq.a2: Yes. While it’s still pending, open it in My Account and choose Cancel order: if it includes a pre-made design you get back everything you paid, and if it holds only custom designs you get back what you paid minus the payment processing fee. Pre-made designs can also be returned within 14 days of collecting them; custom designs can’t be cancelled once they’re in production. See our Refund policy.
info.faq.q3: What file types can I upload?
info.faq.a3: PNG, JPEG, and WebP are supported. For the sharpest print, upload at least 300 DPI at the size you want it printed.
info.faq.q4: Do you print copyrighted or trademarked content?
info.faq.a4: No. You must own or have a licence to use any design you upload. Orders containing infringing or offensive artwork will be cancelled and refunded.
info.faq.q5: What if my item arrives damaged or misprinted?
info.faq.a5: Contact us via the Contact page with your order number and photos. You’re covered by the legal guarantee for two years from collecting it: we’ll reprint it free of charge, or refund you if a reprint isn’t possible. See our Refund policy.
info.faq.q6: Do you deliver to my home, or abroad?
info.faq.a6: We don’t deliver to home addresses: we send your order to the ACS point you choose anywhere in Cyprus — an ACS store or a Smartpoint locker — for a fixed delivery fee, shown at checkout. We don’t ship outside Cyprus at the moment; if you are abroad and still want to order, contact us and we will see what we can do.
info.faq.q7: How do I track my order?
info.faq.a7: Log in and go to My Account › Orders for the latest status. If shipping info is available you'll see a tracking link there.
info.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
info.cookies.subtitle: What cookies we set, why, and how to control them.
info.cookies.intro: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device. Costaspressjr uses them to keep you signed in, remember your cart and language, and keep payments safe.
info.cookies.essential_lead: These are required for the site to work. They cannot be disabled:
info.cookies.essential_phpsessid: PHPSESSID — keeps you signed in and remembers your session.
info.cookies.essential_csrf: A CSRF token stored in your session, used to protect form submissions against cross-site request forgery.
info.cookies.essential_lang: lang — remembers the language you chose, for a year. Set only when you pick a language.
info.cookies.essential_stripe: __stripe_mid and __stripe_sid — set on the checkout page by our payment provider, Stripe, to prevent fraud (kept for a year and for 30 minutes).
info.cookies.preference_lead: Set only after you accept the cookie banner. Used to remember your choices (such as cookie preferences) so you are not re-prompted on every visit.
info.cookies.analytics_lead: We currently do not use third-party analytics or advertising cookies. If this changes we will update this policy and ask for your consent before setting any.
info.cookies.managing_lead: You can block or delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies will prevent sign-in and checkout from working.
info.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
info.privacy.subtitle: What we collect, how we use it, and the controls you have.
info.privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Costaspressjr collects when you use our site and how we handle it.
info.privacy.account_data: Account data — your username, email, phone number (optional), and hashed password.
info.privacy.order_data: Order data — the name, phone number and email you give at checkout, the pickup point you choose, what you ordered, and payment metadata (card brand and last four digits — we never see or store full card numbers).
info.privacy.designs: Designs you upload — images and text you submit for printing.
info.privacy.usage: Usage data — IP address, browser type, and pages visited, used to keep the site running and to detect abuse.
info.privacy.p2: We use your information to take, make and hand over your order and to run your account (to perform our contract with you), to keep the accounting records the law requires (a legal obligation), and to keep the site secure and stop abuse (our legitimate interest). Optional cookies are set only with your consent.
info.privacy.p3: We share only what each of these needs to do its job, and we never sell your personal data:
info.privacy.p4: We use cookies to keep you logged in and remember your preferences. See our Cookie Policy for details.
info.privacy.p5: We keep order and payment records for as long as tax and accounting law requires. Account data stays while your account is open; if you ask us to close it, we delete what we are not required to keep. Support-chat questions the assistant couldn't answer are kept without anything that links them to you.
info.privacy.p6: You have the right to access, correct, delete or export your personal data, to object to or restrict how we use it, and to withdraw your consent at any time. To use any of these rights, email us or use the Contact page. You can also complain to the Office of the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection in Cyprus (dataprotection.gov.cy).
info.privacy.p7: We store passwords hashed, use HTTPS in production, and limit internal access to your data. No system is perfectly secure, so we encourage you to use a strong, unique password.
info.privacy.p8: Reach us through the Contact page for any privacy-related question or request.
info.privacy.placeholder: Placeholder notice: if you sell to customers in the EU, UK, or California, have this policy reviewed for GDPR / UK-GDPR / CCPA compliance before launch.
info.terms.title: Terms of Service
info.terms.subtitle: The agreement between you and Costaspressjr when using this site.
info.terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Costaspressjr website and services (the "Service"). By creating an account, placing an order, or otherwise using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
info.terms.p1: You must provide accurate information when registering and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
info.terms.p2: All orders are subject to availability and acceptance. Prices and product details are shown in your local currency where supported and include applicable taxes where required. Payment is charged at the time of purchase.
info.terms.p3: You retain ownership of any artwork you upload. By submitting a design you confirm that you have the right to use it and grant Costaspressjr a limited licence to reproduce it for the purpose of fulfilling your order. We may refuse to print content that is unlawful, infringing, or offensive.
info.terms.p4: We send orders with ACS to the point you choose; the delivery fee is shown at checkout. Ready-by estimates are not guarantees. Risk of loss passes to you when you collect the order from the ACS point.
info.terms.p5: You can cancel the purchase of items with our pre-made designs within 14 days of collecting them, without giving a reason, and get your money back. Items printed with your own custom designs are made to your specifications, so that right doesn’t apply to them: you can cancel such an order only while it is still pending (before production), and you then get back what you paid minus the payment processing fee. Faulty or misprinted items are covered by the legal guarantee. Our Refund policy has the details and the withdrawal form.
info.terms.p6: The Costaspressjr name, logo, and site content (excluding user-submitted designs) are the property of Costaspressjr. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute site content without permission.

info.shipping.title: Delivery Info
info.shipping.subtitle: Where we send your order, and when.
info.shipping.p1: We print everything to order. Most items are ready within 3–5 business days. Larger orders or complex custom designs may take a little longer.
info.shipping.p2_lead: There is no home delivery. Once your order is printed, we send it with ACS to the point you chose at checkout:
info.shipping.p2_a: From an ACS point — any ACS store or Smartpoint locker in Cyprus, usually 2–5 business days after printing
info.shipping.p2_after: We don't ship outside Cyprus at the moment. If you are abroad and would still like to order, get in touch through the Contact page and we will tell you what is possible.
info.shipping.p3: Delivery to an ACS point costs {fee}, added to your order at checkout.
info.shipping.p4: Check your order's status any time on the Track Order page with the tracking number from checkout, or in My Account. For Smartpoint lockers, ACS texts you a code to open the locker when your parcel arrives.
info.returns.title: Refund policy
info.returns.subtitle: Pre-made designs: 14 days to change your mind. Custom designs are made just for you, so they can’t be returned.
info.returns.h1: Pre-made designs: 14 days to change your mind
info.returns.p1: You can cancel your purchase of items printed with one of our pre-made designs within 14 days of the day you collect them, without giving a reason. You can also cancel before you collect them.
info.returns.p1_how: To cancel, tell us before the 14 days are up: email us, write to us through the Contact page, or send us the model withdrawal form below. A clear statement that you are cancelling is enough. While the order is still Pending, the quickest way is to cancel it yourself (see below).
info.returns.p1_return: If you’ve already collected the items, bring them back to our store or send them to us within 14 days of telling us. You pay the cost of sending them back.
info.returns.p1_refund: We refund what you paid for the items, and the delivery fee too if you cancel the whole order, within 14 days of hearing from you. If you’ve collected them, we may wait to refund until they’re back with us or you’ve shown us you’ve sent them. Please handle them only as you would in a shop: if they come back worn, washed or damaged, we may deduct the loss in their value.
info.returns.h_custom: Custom designs: made only for you
info.returns.p_custom: Items printed with a design you uploaded or made in our designer are made to your specifications, so the 14-day right to cancel doesn’t apply to them. Once your order moves to Processing, its custom-design items are being made for you and can no longer be cancelled or returned.
info.returns.p2: While your order is still Pending, you can cancel it yourself: open it in My Account and choose Cancel order. If you checked out as a guest, contact us with your order number instead. If the order includes a pre-made design, you get back everything you paid. If it holds only custom designs, you get back what you paid minus the payment processing fee charged by our payment provider, Stripe, which isn’t returned to us. The exact amount is shown before you confirm.
info.returns.p3: The refund goes to the card or account you paid with. It usually shows within 5–10 working days, depending on your bank.
info.returns.p4_a: Normal wear and tear after use.
info.returns.p4_b: Damage caused by incorrect washing or care. Follow the care label.
info.returns.p4_c: Custom designs that were proofed and approved by you but contain a typo or artwork error.
info.returns.form_intro: To cancel the purchase of pre-made designs you can use this form: copy it into an email or print it. You don’t have to use it.

checkout.policy.title: Cancellations & returns
checkout.policy.body: Pre-made designs: you can cancel within 14 days of collecting them and get your money back. Custom designs are made just for you, so they can’t be returned; until we start making them, you can cancel from your order page and get back what you paid minus the payment processing fee.
checkout.complete.policy: Changed your mind? Until we start making your order you can cancel it from your order page, or by contacting us. Pre-made designs can also be returned within 14 days of collecting them; custom designs can’t once they’re in production. Your confirmation email has the details.

assistant.disclaimer: Automated answers. Please don't share personal details — for anything about a specific order, contact us.
assistant.error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again, or use the contact page.

assistant.chip.design: How do I add my design?
assistant.fallback.empty: Ask me anything about printing, prices, sizes or delivery.
assistant.fallback.text: Not sure about that one. I can help with prices, delivery, sizes, returns and designing — for anything else, the contact page reaches a person.
assistant.rate_limited: That's a lot of questions! Please use the contact page so a person can help you properly.
assistant.answer.pricing: The more you order, the less each piece costs — up to {percent}% off per item, applied automatically with no codes and no minimum.
assistant.answer.pricing_from: From €{price} per piece; the studio shows your exact price as you build.
assistant.answer.shipping: We send every order to the ACS point you choose anywhere in Cyprus — an ACS store or a Smartpoint locker — for a fixed delivery fee, added at checkout. There’s no home delivery. Most orders are ready within 3–5 business days.
assistant.answer.sizing: Sizes run XS–5XL depending on the garment. Each product page shows the exact range and a measurement chart — worth checking, as fits vary by style.
assistant.answer.design: Pick a garment, then upload your artwork or start from a ready-made design. Print on the front, back and sleeves with a true-to-size preview — no account needed until you order.
assistant.answer.products: We print on: {list}. Colours and sizes vary by garment.
assistant.answer.products_generic: We print on t-shirts, long sleeves, tank tops, v-necks, polos and hoodies, in a range of colours and sizes.
assistant.answer.payment: Card payment, processed securely by Stripe — your card details never reach our servers.
assistant.answer.human: The contact page is the fastest way to reach us — we answer every message.
assistant.answer.greeting: Hello! Ask me about prices, delivery, sizes, or how to get your design printed.
assistant.answer.arrival: Most orders are ready within 3–5 business days; ACS points take another 2–5.
info.privacy.p_assistant_1: The chat assistant on this site answers common questions — prices, delivery, sizes, returns — directly on our own server, using information already published on this website. Those messages are not sent anywhere else.
info.privacy.p_assistant_2: If the assistant cannot answer a question itself, the text of that message may be sent to a third-party AI provider outside the EU so that a reply can be generated. Only the message you typed is sent. Your name, email, account and order details are never attached to it.
info.privacy.p_assistant_3: Please do not type personal details — such as your address, phone number or payment information — into the chat. For anything about a specific order, use the Contact page instead.
info.privacy.p_assistant_4: We keep a record of questions the assistant could not answer, so that we can improve it. That record contains the question text only — it is not linked to you, your session or your account.
info.returns.p4: Everything we sell is covered by the legal guarantee: if an item is faulty, damaged or misprinted, you’re covered for two years from collecting it. Contact us via the Contact page with your order number and photos, ideally as soon as you notice, and we’ll reprint it free of charge — or refund you if a reprint isn’t possible.
